title: Microsoft Purview DLP: guided diagnostics for why a policy acted
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, eligibility, default and Security Copilot controls are supported. The previously reported fetch failures did not recur; two minor corrections would complete the data-access setting path and cite the distinction between personal plugin toggles and organisation-wide restrictions.
